correctness.rationale: The area of the exact two-coordinate rare-gap triangle is delta squared over two. Overlapping adjacent triangles are disjoint for deficit at most one-half; disjoint-pair products are independent and the number of k-subsets without neighbors is binomial(n-k,k), proving the finite polynomial. Fixed-order spatial factorial moments of all marked gap counts converge to independent Poisson count moments, with O(1/n) lost adjacent-index tuples. The resulting finite-intensity point process has Rayleigh minimum and independent uniform spatial mark. 316 exact and numerical reproducibility checks passed.

value.rationale: One-point-per-stratum jitter is a standard low-discrepancy sampling design. Its worst internal gap controls finite mesh coverage and connectivity; knowing the exact probability of a near-worst gap for all sample sizes and the spatial location/size process is more informative than bounding discrepancy or deriving only an approximate mean. The exact hard-core path mechanism and sharp Rayleigh extreme scale materially distinguish this design from iid uniform sampling; the results are a natural complete finite tail and extreme process, not an arbitrary slice.
